name: notion-mention-link
title: Notion Mention Link
description: A Notion-style inline mention of a web page, shown with a tiny favicon and the page title. Hovering it brings up a card with the page's image, summary and domain without leaving the document.
use: Long documents cite other pages and readers should glimpse the target without leaving the text.
avoid: It relies on a server endpoint for page metadata; without one you must pass the metadata yourself.
a11y: The preview opens on hover or focus, but its slide and fade have no reduced-motion fallback. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Body text in a document with an inline chip made of a small square favicon, a grey site name and an underlined bold page title. On hover a rounded card drops below holding a mountain photo, a heading, a short paragraph and the domain.
behaves: Hovering or focusing the link waits a moment, then shows a loading skeleton that settles into the preview card; leaving closes it shortly after. Details can be fetched and cached on mount or on first hover.
customise: Pass the url plus optional metadata (title, description, image, site, domain) and the preview width and height; the fetch endpoint and delays are props too.
weight: light: A link and a hover card; the only work is one cached metadata fetch.
